title: Dukovo Lab finding
description: findings/<id>.json, in the lab PC's store and in the lab-results repository: one way a test fails, with every run it failed in. Version 1.

id.description: f- and 12 hex digits of the FNV-1a 64-bit hash of "<test>\n<signature>", shifted right 16 bits: the same on any PC.

signature.description: How it fails: the first line of its results' reason, less the serial log's path, the time limit and what SSH last answered, spaces collapsed.

state.description: new: nobody has looked at it. not-a-bug: a person on the lab PC said so (with note); never sent again unless asked. fix-proposed, approved, fixed: set in lab-results by the thread fixing it and the maintainer. A fixed finding that fails again is new.

note.description: Why a person said it is not a bug.

first_seen.description: When the first run it failed in started (RFC 3339 UTC).

last_seen.description: When the last run it failed in started (RFC 3339 UTC).

count.description: How many times it failed: one per run and machine.

machines.description: The machines it failed on, in the order first seen.

builds.description: The builds it failed on, in the order first seen.

runs.description: Every time it failed, oldest first.

run.description: The run id: its bundle is runs/<date>/<run>/.

sent.description: Whether the run's bundle is in lab-results.

passing.description: Machines where its test passed again since it last failed there, with the first run it passed in.

fix.description: The pull request that fixes it, set in lab-results.

sent.description: When the lab PC last sent it (RFC 3339 UTC); null in lab-results.
